in_sanskrit.name: Baani
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Giver of Speech
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Baani एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। In Hindu mythology, Baani is the goddess of speech. She is often depicted holding a book or a feather pen. Her name is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘vāc’ meaning speech, and ‘bhān’ meaning to give. Thus, Baani is the giver of speech or the goddess of eloquence.
